reason: The invoice (event-022, tap-works-invoice.pdf) is for Flat 4, 28 Larkspur Quay, Brindlewick. Our job is Flat 4, 8-12 Juniper Mews, Vellumford (index, event-020), so the property check failed. The invoice also states no amount, and the landlord approval (event-004) is a general "proceed" with no figure. The invoice covers only the two taps. Nothing records any investigation of the bathroom vent leak or the bedroom damp, and the damp was never triaged for health impact. The completion signal (event-014) was retracted in event-015, so it is not proof. I am not closing, paying or telling the landlord the work is done. The question for Gareth is a single one, which property the invoice is for, so asking him is enough and escalation isn't needed yet. I also asked him for an itemised amount and a visit report on the vent and damp. Priority is P2: there is no reported danger, but the water ingress and damp are unresolved. A follow-up is set for 72 hours. Open items that need their own handling: the landlord's insurance and roof-leak history requests (event-004, event-005) are still undone, and the landlord has had no update since event-012. A person should pick these up, and should escalate if the damp turns out to affect health.
message: Hi Gareth, thanks for the invoice NBL-003-INV-14 dated 14 September. It shows the property as Flat 4, 28 Larkspur Quay, Brindlewick, ZZ1 1ZZ. Our job, and your visit on Friday 12 September, was for Flat 4, 8-12 Juniper Mews, Vellumford, ZZ1 1ZZ. Please confirm which property the invoice is for, and send a corrected invoice if it is wrong. The invoice also shows no amount. Please include an itemised total. Please also send your visit report. It should say what you found on the bathroom vent rainwater leak and the smaller bedroom damp, and whether any further work is needed. We can't process the invoice until this is confirmed. Kind regards, Priya Nair, Northbridge Lettings
